id: title:CShine612:add a first message length input to get ticket

observations.behavior: Adds a new helper function firstCustomerMessageQuery that returns an empty string when opts are missing or the include flag is not explicitly true.
observations.posthog_connection: This establishes the default behavior for opt-in retrieval of customer message previews in Slack workflows.

observations.code_quote: { name: 'does not request the field by default', inputs: {}, query: '' },
observations.behavior: Replaces individual tests with parameterized assertions covering multiple input combinations and edge cases. Tests zero-length treatment, text parsing, fraction truncation, and bounds on huge numbers.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides comprehensive test coverage for argument handling and URL construction, including Django compatibility safeguards against exponent notation and invalid values.

observations.code_quote: description: 'Bytes of the first message to include, from 200 to 3,000. Leave empty for the short preview.',
observations.behavior: Adds a template configuration entry defining the optional numeric input first_customer_message_max_bytes with documentation and metadata.
observations.posthog_connection: Makes this capability available as a configurable option within PostHog's destination templates without requiring backend changes.

observations.limitations: The implementation relies on external API compatibility; no response body processing or error recovery is shown. Tier elevation depends on unverified runtime behavior rather than demonstrated benefit.
